cursor.restartHint: Reload Cursor to pick up the new server.
quirks: Expands ${VAR} in command, args, env, url and headers.

claude-code.restartHint: Start a new Claude Code session.
quirks: The CLI needs -- before the stdio command, so --env has to be spliced in ahead of the server name.
Project-scope servers require approval on first use.
User-scope entries are keyed per project inside ~/.claude.json, which is why the CLI is preferred over editing the file.
Config is TOML — a [mcp_servers.<name>] table — so there is no file fallback: without the codex command on PATH the install refuses rather than writing JSON into config.toml.
Status is the exit code of `codex mcp get`, because there is no file this installer can parse.
Does not expand ${VAR}: --env writes literal values, so the API key has to be passed with --api-key or inherited from the environment Codex was launched in.

antigravity.restartHint: Restart Antigravity to pick up the new server.
quirks: Uses serverUrl rather than url for remote servers. Irrelevant here — this server is stdio — but it is why an Antigravity config cannot be copied from a Cursor one.
The IDE, the agy CLI and the SDK share one config file.

copilot.restartHint: Switch Copilot Chat to Agent mode — MCP tools are only available there.
quirks: The top-level key is servers, not mcpServers.
The file is JSONC: comments are preserved on write.
Does not expand ${VAR} in env, so the API key has to be passed with --api-key or inherited from the environment Kiro was launched in.
The Add to Kiro deeplink writes its own entry; running init afterwards overwrites it with this one.
